subtitle.v: Xử lý %s phiếu lịch sử cuộc gọi

query.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000)
exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join (select referenceId, ma_so_thue, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), datetime0, 120) ngay_goi, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), datetime2, 120) ngay_kt from lscuocgoi) b on a.referenceId = b.referenceId', 'b.ngay_goi, b.ngay_kt', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId

finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = ''
set @strKey = 'CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), calldate, 23) between ''' + convert(varchar(32), @ngay_ct1, 23) + ''' and ''' + convert(varchar(32), @ngay_ct2, 23) + ''' and ' + @strFinding set @strKey = @strKey + ' and a.disposition = ''ANS'' '
exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join (select referenceId, ma_so_thue, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), datetime0, 120) ngay_goi, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), datetime2, 120) ngay_kt from lscuocgoi) b on a.referenceId = b.referenceId', 'b.ngay_goi, b.ngay_kt', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId

dir.script:
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 1 then 5 when 5 then 1 else 5 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 1 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 1 then getdate() else null end
update lscuocgoi set status = @deststatus, user_id_duyet = @uid, ngay_duyet = @dduyet where referenceId in (select referenceId from @tblKeys)
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
&VoucherJSLoading;
